title: Granite-4.0-H-Tiny layer-0 folding excerpt
subtitle: P7.6 fixture: 8 real macro slots of the shipped Granite atlas, plus the folding and decode-pass extension blocks the folding card and the macro time-lane view read. Decode only (D25).

provenance.author: P7.6 hand fixture. chips[], macros[], tiles[], cards[] and the link byte law are copied VERBATIM from granite_4_0_h_tiny.json (emitted by fws_atlas_export from a real mapping and priced by P4); folding[] and passes[] are hand-authored against those rows because no producer emits them yet.
grounded: chips[], macros[], tiles[] and cards[] are copied row for row from granite_4_0_h_tiny.json
macros[].duty_cycle and macros[].digital_pool are P4's measured values, copied
the folding cards' K, N and cell counts are read off those copied tiles
passes[].boxes[] enumerate the mux banks of the copied macros and name the copied tile each pass drives
metrics[] prefixed run. are quoted from granite_4_0_h_tiny.json and say so in their basis
provenance.note: Two kinds of number live here. Everything copied from granite_4_0_h_tiny.json is a measured placement or a measured time. Everything the folding block adds is a MAPPING the packer has not written yet (P7.2/P7.3 are open): the enumerated blocks, banks and pass counts are exact arithmetic on the copied shapes, the seconds are a marked placeholder, and every energy is reported as UNCOVERED because no card declares the law. The chip here is an 8-slot EXCERPT of a 640-slot chiplet: its slot count and occupancy are facts about the excerpt.

relaxations.value: 8 of 6400 analog macro slots, layer 0 only
relaxations.reason: this document is an EXCERPT built to exercise the folding views. Every excerpt. metric is a fact about the excerpt and every run. metric names the whole-model run it was quoted from. No figure here is an excerpt throughput.

relaxations.value: P7.2 (dense packer) and P7.3 (per-tensor folds) are open
relaxations.reason: the variants enumerate what a fold WOULD place, computed exactly from the copied tile shapes. No mapper has emitted them, so the seconds carry the fixture_invented mark and the areas state which accounting they use.
derived as the measured macro duty share of the measured decode step divided by the card's 4 banks. It is the right shape, not a priced law; P7.2's packer replaces it.

relaxations.value: 0 laws price a reduction, a partial-sum transport or a per-bank ADC pass
relaxations.reason: the reference run discloses reduction_energy and shared_digital_energy as ABSENT laws. Every variant therefore reports energy as uncovered instead of printing a zero that would read as a measurement (D21).

folding.decode_only: Decode only (D25). Every variant on this page is one decode step of the batched-synchronous regime (D15); prefill folding is refused by name below.
folding.invariant_w: Weight space is never wasted (D27): a fold moves a tensor's cells between banks and macros, it never changes how many cells there are, and every variant reports the remainder it leaves.

refused.reason: no shipped card slices (bits_per_cell is null on both P2 cards, ADJ-4), so a slice x fold product has nothing to be about.
a second copy of a tensor idles or duplicates weight space that decode cannot use; Invariant W forbids it.
splitting K when K <= the card's rows costs one extra pass and an accumulator and buys nothing: one column already holds the whole K.
prefill runs concurrent layers and SSD chunking; P7 is decode only.
a second model's tiles sharing these banks is the same machinery later, named and empty today.
overlapping decode steps leaves D15's batched-synchronous regime.
spreading a tensor over more macros than the cell floor idles banks; weight space is never wasted.

cards.label: ssm_out_proj, layer 0 - where the K partials meet

tensor.label: granite_4_0_h_tiny L0 ssm_out_proj (d_inner 3072 -> hidden 1536)
tensor.basis: the two tiles sys.fws.tile.000005 and sys.fws.tile.000006 of granite_4_0_h_tiny.json share one owner tuple and carry K = 1536 each: they are the row partitions of one 3072 x 1536 matrix (SCHEMA.md, tiles[] row partitions). N = 6448 on the sibling ssm_in_proj fixes d_inner = 3072 (2 x 3072 + 2 x 1 x 128 + 48).

cards.floor_basis: cells / (rows x stored_cols) = 4718592 / 2359296 = 2 macro slots exactly, the global cell floor for this tensor (D27).

variants.label: K blocks spread across macros (as placed)
variants.note: Today's placement: one K block per macro, the two partial vectors meet in a cross-macro adder tree.

accumulator.basis: one partial vector leaves macro 000006 per step: N 1536 x batch 4 x act 2.0 B = 12288 B, the same byte law links[].basis states for the activation handoff. It is priced by the shift-and-add tree law on the per-macro pool (the reference run's row_block_partial_sum_law disclosure).

waste.basis: two macro slots hold 4718592 of 4718592 committed cells: this tensor sits exactly on its floor and wastes nothing. Itemized as cim_timing.dense_pack itemizes it (P7.2): remainder + tail.

area.basis: 2 enumerated macro slots x macro_footprint_mm2 2.0204136 (the P2 card). Under Invariant W a fold never frees a slot for nothing: the saving from packing is global and the frontier reports it, not this card.
uncovered: accumulator_mm2: no card declares an accumulator or partial-sum-buffer area law (absent law, not a measured zero)

time.basis: 8 enumerated ADC passes x the placeholder per-pass time 1.1832046216093002e-07 s (passes[].pass_time_basis). The pass COUNT is exact; the seconds are the placeholder.

energy.uncovered: no card knob prices a reduction or a partial-sum transport: the reference run discloses reduction_energy 0 pJ as an ABSENT law, so this variant reports no energy rather than a zero.

variants.label: K blocks stacked in one macro (N split in half)
variants.note: The same two K blocks, both resident in one macro's banks, with N cut in half so each macro owns half the output columns. The partials meet in the macro's own pool and nothing crosses the boundary.

boxes.label: macro slot 0 - N half 0, both K blocks
macro slot 1 - N half 1, both K blocks

accumulator.basis: an in-macro accumulator moves no partial off the macro: the transport term is 0 by construction, and the adder tree is priced on the per-macro pool by the same law (D12, P2 price_reduction).

waste.basis: the same two macro slots hold the same 4718592 cells: a fold moves the cells, it never changes how many there are (D27).

area.basis: 2 enumerated macro slots x macro_footprint_mm2 2.0204136 - IDENTICAL to the spread variant. Analog silicon is the cell floor and the fold does not move it (P7 Fact 1).
uncovered: accumulator_mm2: no card declares an accumulator or partial-sum-buffer area law (absent law, not a measured zero). This is the term that would separate the two variants, and it is the Samyak parameter ask P7 names.

time.basis: 8 enumerated ADC passes, the same count as the spread variant: at the floor every bank still fires once per step (P7 Fact 1). Seconds carry the same placeholder per-pass time.

energy.uncovered: no card knob prices a reduction; the 12288 B/step this variant does NOT send is a byte count, not a joule count, until a card declares a transport energy law.

cards.label: router, layer 0 - the waste card

tensor.label: granite_4_0_h_tiny L0 router (hidden 1536 -> 64 experts)
tensor.basis: sys.fws.tile.000007 of granite_4_0_h_tiny.json, verbatim: K 1536, N 64.

cards.floor_basis: 98304 cells is 4.17% of one macro slot's 2359296 cells: this tensor cannot fill a slot and must share one (D27).

variants.label: one tensor, one macro (as placed)
variants.note: Today's placement gives a 64-column tensor a whole macro slot. Three of the four banks fire on no pass and hold no weights: this is the waste Invariant W exists to remove, drawn.

accumulator.basis: K 1536 equals the card's rows: one column already holds the whole K, so there is no partial to meet. Splitting it anyway is the non_canonical_walk this register refuses.

waste.basis: (1536 - 64) unowned columns x 1536 rows of the one slot this tensor holds, itemized as P7.2 itemizes it: remainder 491520 cells inside the committed bank + tail 1769472 cells in the three banks the stream never reached. macros[].occupancy prints 0.0417 for the same macro and measures COLUMNS; waste is CELLS (D27).

area.basis: 1 enumerated macro slot x macro_footprint_mm2 2.0204136: the whole slot is spent on this tensor because nothing else is placed beside it.
uncovered: accumulator_mm2: this variant has no accumulator; the term is null because no card declares the law, not because it is zero

time.basis: 1 enumerated ADC pass x the placeholder per-pass time. The other three bank passes of this macro drive nothing and are not this tensor's time.

energy.uncovered: no card knob prices an ADC pass's energy per bank; the reference run's energy total is a whole-timeline figure and splitting it per tensor would be a second accounting (D21).

variants.label: dense packing: the tensor shares its bank (Invariant W)
variants.note: The router's 64 columns and ssm_in_proj's real 304-column remainder are 368 of one bank's 384 columns; the other three banks carry ssm_out_proj blocks. Two passes now fire on bank 0 because two tensors live there - co-residency is free in decode, where layers run in sequence (P7 Fact 3).

accumulator.basis: co-tenants produce different outputs: there is no partial to accumulate, only a second pass on the shared bank.

waste.basis: 64 + 304 = 368 of the bank's 384 columns are held; the 16-column remainder x 1536 rows is a DIMENSION-MISMATCH remainder, which is the only waste D27 admits, and it is reported here.

area.basis: the tensor's cell share of one macro slot: 98304 / 2359296 x macro_footprint_mm2 2.0204136. Dense packing means the slot is not spent on this tensor alone, so its cost to the floor is its cells, not a slot.
uncovered: accumulator_mm2: no accumulator in this variant and no card law for one

time.basis: 1 enumerated ADC pass for THIS tensor - unchanged. The co-tenant on the same bank pays its own pass, which is why dense packing costs passes only where two tensors share one bank.

energy.uncovered: no card knob prices an ADC pass's energy per bank.

passes.label: one decode step of the layer-0 excerpt, as placed

step.basis: one BEAT of the reference run (granite_4_0_h_tiny.json is a FILLED PIPELINE under D29: 10 resident streams, one token out per beat, and the lowered window is 10 fill beats plus 3 steady ones). Every stage fires every beat, so a beat is the window in which this macro walks its banks once. Decode only (D25): no prefill schedule is carried.

passes.pass_time_basis: PLACEHOLDER: macros[].duty_cycle 0.0019211568669396213 of the reference run x the run's measured BEAT 4.3980873140034174e-05 s = 8.4494156446976995e-08 s of analog activity per macro per beat, divided by this card's 4 mux banks. No producer emits a per-pass law yet; P7.2 replaces this number.
